subject: Castle of Ordeals
text: The recommended path is to journey first to the Castle of Ordeals in the north, then to the Ice Cave, and finally to Gurgu Volcano.

evidence.quote:
The first place to journey to will be the Castle of Ordeals in the
     north, then the Ice Cave, and finally onto Gurgu Volcano (this is the
     path I recommend and follow for this FAQ, but it is not a mandatory
     decision).

subject: Castle of Ordeals
text: To reach the Castle of Ordeals, sail north past the Power Peninsula, head west until north of the Temple of Fiends, sail north along the western coast, enter a small river leading inland by Canoe, and walk south to the castle.

evidence.quote:
Once you are ready, it is time to move west until you
are just to the north of the Temple of Fiends (use your B + SELECT to see
the World Map).  Once you are there, head north until you hit some land.
You will then go north along the western coast of this land mass, and you
will soon see a Castle to the east, surrounded by marsh (this is your goal).
Continue north along the coast until you find a small river leading inland,
which is where you will disembark from your ship as you Canoe south on the
river.  Leave the river when it bends and continue south on foot until you
reach the Castle of ordeals

subject: CROWN
text: Showing the old man the CROWN is required to enter the upper levels of the Castle of Ordeals to prove your courage.

evidence.quote:
Move forward to show the old man your CROWN as it is required for entering
the upper levels of the Castle to prove your courage.

subject: Throne
text: Stepping onto the throne in the upper-right corner of the floor starts the journey through the Castle of Ordeals.

evidence.quote:
Head to the up-right corner of the floor and set foot onto the
throne to start your journey!

subject: Pillar Maze
text: To navigate the teleportation floor, touch the single pillar in rooms one and two, the bottom pillar in room three, the single pillar in room four, the bottom pillar in room five, the single pillar down the hall in room six, and the right pillar in room seven.

evidence.quote:
The first
two rooms have one pillar only, so go touch them to warp forward.  The third
room has two, so choose the bottom one.  The fourth room has one choice,
which leads to the fifth room that has two (choose the bottom one).  The
sixth room is a long hall leading down to a single pillar, which is followed
by room seven where the right pillar is the one to choose to advance.

subject: MUDGOL
text: Mudgols have 176 HP, yield 800 Gold and 1257 Exp, have no real weak point, and can cast Fast.

evidence.quote:
They
have a high damage stat, and that can be furthered by their special ability
of using Fast!  They have no real weak point so attack them with your
weaponry and strongest Magic attacks to take them down before they can use
their brutal attacking abilities.

subject: Zeus Gauntlet
text: The treasure chest behind the Mudgol fight contains the Zeus Gauntlet, which casts Lit2 when used as an item in battle.

evidence.quote:
open up the Treasure Chest to
find the Zeus Gauntlet, which is not only a good Gauntlet for a
Fighter/Knight, Red Wizard, or Ninja, but it also has the honour of being
the first Weapon/Armor that you have found that can be used as an Item in
battle and have an effect.  When used as an Item, it will cast Lit2 every
time!

subject: Stairs to Next Floor
text: Leaving the Zeus Gauntlet room, taking the path down on the left, and touching the lower pillar warps the party to the room with the stairs leading to the next floor.

evidence.quote:
Now head out the door, take the path down ON THE LEFT (not the one
directly below the door), and then touch the lower pillar of the two here
to appear in the room with the stairway leading to the next floor!

subject: NITEMARE
text: Nitemares have 200 HP, yield 700 Gold and 1272 Exp, use Snort, and are weak to Ice.

evidence.quote:
their only special ability is
to Snort (Dark spell).  They have a weakness to Ice, so let them have it
with Ice2 while the rest of the party attacks, and you will quickly win this
fight!

subject: Heal Staff
text: A treasure chest above the Nitemare fight contains the Heal Staff, which casts Heal on the entire party at no spell charge cost when used as an item in battle.

evidence.quote:
Go open the Treasure Chest above to get a Heal Staff (when used as an Item
in battle, it will cast Heal on your entire party so it is useful for
keeping the Hit points up for no cost to your spell charges)

or Red Mage), and a Gold Bracelet (give to a Mage).

subject: ZOMBIE DRAGON
text: Zombie Dragons have 268 HP, yield 999 Gold and 2331 Exp, can stun fighters, and are weak against Fire and Harm spells.

evidence.quote:
You will have to brawl with a couple undead Dragons that have a high attack
power (they can also stun your fighters with their attack)!  Since they are
undead, Fire and harm spells will just decimate them, so do not be shy in
handing out some of those spell charges!

subject: Throne
text: Stepping onto the throne after defeating the Zombie Dragons warps the party back to the first floor to exit the Castle of Ordeals.

evidence.quote:
Once you have had your fill of the Zombie D's, step forward
onto the throne and warp back to the first floor.  Head down and to the
right to exit the Castle Of ordeals

subject: Ice Cave
text: To reach the Ice Cave by Canoe, follow the river stream to the northwest branch, turn east past the upward fork, head south into the west fork, disembark onto dry land, and head east and north.

evidence.quote:
Follow the stream till the branch appears, taking the northwest route.
Follow that current route, turning east and following it east past the fork
leading up.  Head south to take the west fork, and then follow that waterway
to dry land once again.  Head east and then north to find the entrance of
the Ice Cave!

subject: Ice Cave
text: Before exploring the Ice Cave, bring 99 Heal Potions and around 5 to 15 Soft Potions to survive damaging floors, status killers, and one-hit killers.

evidence.quote:
Far and away the toughest challenge yet, this cave will bring lots of heavy
hitters, damaging floor sections, undead stunners, status killers, and one
hit killers.  Bring 99 Heal Potions, around 5 to 15 Soft Potions, and your
ability to run as much as possible so you can to get through alive!

subject: Entrance Stairway
text: From the Ice Cave entrance, head right along the top wall, cut down as the passage opens, and turn left to reach a stairway leading downward.

evidence.quote:
Head right from the entrance along the top wall, cutting down when the
passage opens up below, and then cut left to find a stairway leading
downwards.
